description: Fork of exp251 (1.6026 @ 8K, V2D learnable T init=0.1 SOTA). Single change: swap SoftMultiHeadLUT(hard=True, learnable_temps=True) for TinyMultiHeadLut(backward_mode='soft', learnable_temps=True). Identical math (gradients exact at fp32, bf16-noise at bf16) but pure-PyTorch fast path: forward = TinyMHLut sign-pack + embedding_bag (compile-fused), backward = pure-PyTorch soft path (compile-fused, recomputes p/ts/sel_soft in registers). Goal: validate quality reproduces exp251=1.6026.
